defects_reproduced: Contract reference pagination is discarded and the declared 14-90-day expiration bounds are not implemented.
Synthetic future-dated bars for options on a different underlying earn a 70-point bullish tier when the recent put population is missing.
FINRA daily short-sale percentage declines become SHORTS_COVERING and raise that unsupported score to 85.
Duplicate contracts double-count the same bars and missing put sessions become zero; ratios use an invented denominator floor of one.
Three source rows populate both recent and older windows, labeled five-day, creating a misleading zero change.
A wrong-issuer JPY quote with boolean price becomes spot 1. Denied contract responses become an indistinguishable empty chain.
FINRA wrong-date records, ratios over 100 percent and duplicate symbols survive the original parser.
